'''August 2001 Columbus tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Columbus, Ohio in August 2001. It is known from Alex George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2891">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-cincinnati-oh-8-25-01d2891/ cincinnati-oh-8-25-01], DeckTech (Alex "george3785" George, 25 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-cincinnati-oh-8-25-01d2891/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' August 2001
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
